chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The fresh fish melts the fat of the two eyes.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating fresh fish according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this concise hadith from Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal properties of fresh fish, specifically its ability to reduce ocular fat, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of integrating physical health with spiritual guidance. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on *al-tibb al-nabawi* (Prophetic medicine), where natural foods are viewed as divine remedies for maintaining bodily purity and function.

en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The fresh fish melts the fat of the two eyes’.
en.sarwar: 9. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ali ibn Hassan from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Fresh fish melts the fat of the eyes.’”
